name: Serial Investigation
source:
Serial Investigation is a short visual novel about town detective Eleanora taking over a serial murder case. A few months after the previous detective gave up the case and retired, Detective Eleanora took charge in the search for the town killer.

It has been a year since the first victim's life was taken. Will she finally find the culprit that has been plaguing the town in fear?

[From [url=https://pitouhui.itch.io/serial-investigation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《连环搜查》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述小镇侦探埃莉诺拉接手调查一桩连环杀人案的故事。在前任侦探放弃此案并退休数月后，埃莉诺拉侦探正式接管了追缉小镇真凶的重任。

距离第一名受害者遇害已过去整整一年。她最终能否揪出那名令整座小镇笼罩在恐惧之中的真凶？

[摘自[url=https://pitouhui.itch.io/serial-investigation]itch.io[/url]]
